title: Finn 2024 · Body image and headphone looming PPS
citation: Finn et al. (2024). The impact of body image on social cognition: Fear of negative evaluation mediates the relationship between body surveillance and interpersonal distance in women. Body Image, 51, 101777.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.audio: Three-second 44.1 kHz pink-noise approach presented over headphones by increasing level.
published_method.tactile: Nonpainful vibration on left index finger, attached with medical tape.
published_method.response: Blindfolded participant presses the space bar with right index on vibration and ignores the sound.
published_method.outcomes: Compare delay-dependent RT and an individual PPS slope against body-image measures. Active and passive interpersonal distance use separate physical assessments.
published_method.baseline: Correct paired RT with tactile-only observations. Exact pooling and sign conventions are unreported.

stimulus_type.value: Looming pink noise over headphones plus left-index vibration

source_provenance.value: 3000 ms rising pink-noise clips at 44.1 kHz, Arduino and LabView 8
source_provenance.gap: Headphone model, signal identity, bit depth, channels, SPL, gain law and distance mapping unreported.

trajectory_count.gap: One approach trajectory family follows from the single reported direction.

trajectory_path.value: Perceived approaching sound through intensity increase
trajectory_path.gap: Only ordinal positions at five delays. No calibrated spatial trajectory.

stimulus_speed.gap: No distance or velocity was measured.

gain_envelope.gap: No exact curve or absolute levels.

renderer_or_apparatus.gap: Hardware model and exact calibration unavailable.

blocked_or_random_order.gap: Block count and sequence generation unreported.

iti_jitter_policy.gap: Overall task lasted approximately 12–15 min. No trial-level interval rule is reported.

response_window.gap: Speeded response required. No deadline or feedback timing.

value.gap: Exact stimulator, drive signal, pulse duration, acceleration and threshold procedure unreported.

tactile_stimulus.gap: Exact stimulator, drive signal, pulse duration, acceleration and threshold procedure unreported.

value.correction: Participant means for D1–D5 corrected using unimodal RTs
value.gap: The exact subtractor, pooling or matching rule, and signed correction convention are unreported.

baseline_strategy.source: Accepted manuscript §§2.4, 3.1, and Table 1 and Accepted manuscript §2.2.9, Peripersonal space
baseline_strategy.gap: The exact subtractor, pooling or matching rule, and signed correction convention are unreported.

catch_trial_type.value: Looming sound with no tactile cue

implementation_gaps: Requires the original noise and headphone output calibration plus a physically characterized tactile route. Exact vibration duration, envelope, output level and acoustic-to-distance mapping are unavailable.
Exact intertrial scheduling, response cutoff and baseline correction rule remain unresolved.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
